chunks: Munḏir ibn Muḥammad ibn Qābūs narrated to me, from Manṣūr ibn al-Sindī, from Abū Dāwūd al-Mustariq, from Thaʿlabah ibn Maymūn, from Mālik al-Juhanī, from al-Ḥārith ibn al-Mughīrah, from al-Aṣbagh ibn Nubātah, who said:

I came to Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام and found him deep in thought, tracing in the ground. So I said: O Amīr al-Muʾminīn, why do I see you pondering and tracing in the ground? Is it out of some desire for it?

He said: No, by Allah. I have never desired it, nor the world, for even a single day at all. Rather, I was thinking about a child who will be from my loins, the eleventh of my descendants. He is the Mahdī who will fill the earth with justice and equity just as it had been filled with tyranny and oppression. There will be for him a ghaybah (occultation) and a state of bewilderment in which some people will go astray and others will be guided.
So I said: O Amīr al-Muʾminīn, how long will the bewilderment and the occultation be? He said: Six days, or six months, or six years.

I said: And will this indeed come to pass? He said: Yes, just as he is created. And how could you grasp this matter, O Aṣbagh? Those are the best of this Ummah together with the best of the righteous of this ʿItrah.
I said: Then what will happen after that? He said: Then Allah does whatever He wills, for He has badaʾāt, wills, goals, and endpoints.

key_terms.الْمَهْدِيُّ: the guided Imam from the descendants of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام who will establish justice
key_terms.بَدَاءَاتٍ: manifestations of divine alteration in the unfolding of decreed matters
key_terms.حَيْرَةٌ: bewilderment or confusion affecting people during the occultation
key_terms.ظُلْمًا: oppression and wrongdoing spread across the earth
key_terms.عَدْلًا: justice; the just order the Mahdī will establish on earth
key_terms.غَيْبَةٌ: occultation; a period in which the Imam is absent from public appearance
key_terms.قِسْطًا: equity and fairness in governance and judgment

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith from al-Kāfī say about the ghaybah of al-Mahdī عليه السلام and the confusion during it?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام spoke about the future birth of the eleventh from his descendants, identified as al-Mahdī, who will fill the earth with justice after it has been filled with oppression. It also mentions his ghaybah (occultation), the confusion that will accompany it, and that some will go astray while others remain guided. The narration concludes by affirming that Allah acts as He wills in accordance with His decree.
